_comment: Leaves of minecraft:block/oak_leaves (the pack's texture), in the order they fall: the user's own leaf shapes, order M (least like the drawn oak leaf first, darker first among similar). Each leaf: its pixels as x,y. stages: how many have fallen at stage 1, 2, 3, 4 (after that all). The user's two green leaves fall last: stage 4 keeps only them.
